title: Otomi mission
notes: Transcriptions and Spanish translations of Otomi-language mission texts: the García and Martín manuscripts (Otomi and Spanish, held in the Archivo General de la Nación, Mexico) and the Codices of Jilotepec and Huichapan, with a table of Otomi phonemes as an aid. The paleographies are by David Charles Wright Carr, published by Éditions SUP-INFOR (Marc Thouvenot); the García and Martín files date from 2000, the codices and phoneme table from 2002. Each text has an excerpt viewer, an information page and a downloadable ZIP. Each download entry is marked with a copyright sign; no further licence terms are given. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
